P_0x00DD62.en: A priestess of the holy kingdom of Langran, and high priestess of the Solatis Temple. She has deep ties to Masaki and the other <Masoukishin> pilots, and Familia was built by her.

P_0x00DE32.en: A member of the "L&E Corporation" and the designer of the Excellence Rescue. Diligent and hard-working. As she had always wished, she rebuilt the new Excellence into a machine for rescue operations.

P_0x00DF39.en: Ryuusei's mother. She appears gentle, but is a woman of firm will. After Ryuusei's father died, she raised him alone. Though frail and in and out of hospitals, she is now recovering and resting at home.

P_0x00E082.en: A <Boosted Children> from the <School>. A member of Argent Class, ranked just below the top Aurum Class. Competitive and proud, she is fixated on earning credit and money.

P_0x00E1A7.en: A <Boosted Children> from the <School>. A member of Argent Class, ranked just below the top Aurum Class. Belligerent and cruel by nature, he despises being a loser and is obsessed with being a winner.

P_0x00E2CD.en: A <Boosted Children> from the <School>. A member of Argent Class, ranked just below the top Aurum Class. Cynical, taciturn, and easily annoyed by trouble.

P_0x00E3E4.en: Read as "Kanan." An immortal of Baral. Calm in manner but very proud, both her appearance and bearing are masculine, hiding an inner fierceness. She does not scorn humans; rather, she feels a duty-bound need to show the way to her much younger siblings, who still fail to grasp the way of things. Before her shikai (shedding the human body to become an immortal), she was a beauty in men's clothing. Full name: Kanan Jun.

P_0x00E658.en: Read as "Taihou." An immortal of Baral. A person who basically affirms everything with "Well done, well done," having realized that resisting or submitting, living or dying, are all equally without purpose. He acts as Kanan's mentor, and while accepting her every word and deed with the same "Well done, well done," he treats her like his own daughter. Full name: Taihou Sandayu.
